checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: Name reads exactly 'Mooncrumb' in dark navy
must.why: Image 1 shows clean navy 'Mooncrumb'. In image 2 (the transparent version) the text is smeared and barely legible.

must.item: Gold crescent moon above the name
must.why: Gold crescent sits above the lettering in image 1. In image 2 it is surrounded by a blurry glow.

must.item: Transparent surround, no opaque rectangle or checkerboard
must.why: Image 2 shows a dark, smeared gradient filling the whole square. No clean transparency is visible.

must.item: Moon and letter edges intact, no halos or missing strokes
must.why: In image 2 the edges are blurred, there is a heavy glow around the moon, and the final 'b' is cut off or faded.

exact_text.read_as: Mooncrumb (clean in image 1; smeared but roughly legible in image 2)

faults.what: The transparent-PNG output (image 2) is a dark, blurry, smeared mess. The lettering is nearly illegible and the moon has a glow. It does not look like a clean cutout.
The background removal appears to have failed or corrupted the image. It may be a rendering artefact, but as delivered it is not usable on different backgrounds.
The original on white (image 1) is fine. The moon is small relative to the wordmark, and the layout has a lot of empty space.

summary: The original on white is a clean, correct logo, but the delivered transparent version appears as a blurry, dark, glowing smear with a cut-off lettering edge, so it is not usable.
